Description-This command is used to control display brightness.-BCTRL: Brightness Control Block On/Off, This bit is always used to switch brightness for display.0 = Off (Brightness register are 00h, DBV[7:0])1 = On (Brightness register are active, according to the other parameters.)-DD: Display Dimming (Only for manual brightness setting)DD = 0: Display Dimming is off.DD = 1: Display Dimming is on.-BL: Backlight Control On/Off0 = Off (Completely turn off backlight circuit. Control lines must be low.)1 = On-Dimming function is adapted to the brightness registers for display when bit BCTRL is changed at DD=1.-When BL bit changed from 'on' to 'off', backlight is turned off without gradual dimming, even if dimming-on (DD=1) are selected.
